SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT APR_NO, APR_COUNT FROM ICOMAPRH_IF WHERE IF_FLAG = 'K' AND IF_ACT_YN = 'X'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT APR_NO, APR_COUNT, STATUS, SUBJECT, UP_REMARK, SECURITY_LVL, URGENCY_YN, UP_USER_ID, UP_DATE, UP_TIME, CONSERVATION_YEAR, SMS_YN, SIGN_STATUS, APR_NO_IKEN FROM ICOMAPRH_IF WHERE IF_FLAG = 'K' AND IF_ACT_YN = 'X' AND APR_NO = $APR_NO$ AND APR_COUNT = $APR_COUNT$ ORDER BY APR_NO, APR_COUNT
UPDATE ICOMAPRH_IF SET IF_ACT_YN = 'Y' WHERE IF_FLAG = 'K' AND IF_ACT_YN = 'X' AND APR_NO = $APR_NO$ AND APR_COUNT = $APR_COUNT$
